source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 28 (standard employment: required to work at least 22 hours a week; employees tax from the tables) with the 2027 rates of tax
notes: Required to work exactly 22 hours a week: standard employment (G21 p. 27-28, summary table rows 1-2), so the tables apply, not the flat 25% (R3 000.00). R12 000 a month = R144 000 a year: tax 18% x 144 000 = 25 920 less the primary rebate 17 820 = 8 100, / 12 = R675.00 (2027 brackets and rebate, SARS rates of tax for individuals). UIF 120.00 and SDL 120.00 (1% each, under the UIF ceiling). Net 12 000 - 675 - 120 = 11 205. This is the 22-hour boundary: ts-non-standard-under-5h-day-flat-25pct is the same employee class one side of it (under 22 hours, taxed flat). Replaces sage-2027-03-marco's hours-blind Sage figure (spec section 4 TS-b), with the adversarial reviewer's written agreement.
